title: AI Governance Lead
description: Role Summary Own the design and execution of the enterprise AI governance program. Build the standards, policies, and procedures that govern how AI use cases and models move from idea to production. Structure the governance roadmap across intake, classification, value assessment, and control design. Stand up use case governance and model governance functions, define the target state for AI governance across the organization, and drive an implementation plan with clear monitoring, prioritized against engineering delivery timelines. Key Responsibilities Governance Framework Design Author and maintain AI governance standards, policies, and procedures covering the full lifecycle of AI use cases and models Design the governance roadmap organized into intake, classification, value assessment, and control design stages Define risk tiers and controls proportional to use case risk (e.g., low/medium/high risk classification tied to required controls) Use Case Governance Build the intake process for new AI use cases: how requests enter the pipeline, what information is captured, who reviews them Establish classification criteria (risk level, data sensitivity, regulatory exposure, business criticality) Design value assessment methodology to prioritize use cases against cost, risk, and business impact Define control requirements per classification tier (documentation, testing, sign-off, monitoring) Model Governance Establish model risk management practices: validation, documentation, versioning, approval gates Define requirements for model cards, testing evidence, bias/fairness checks, and performance monitoring Set standards for third-party and open-source model vetting Target State & Team Build Define the target state for AI governance: what "good" looks like, what the organization should expect from the function Design the governance team structure, roles, and operating model Set RACI across governance, engineering, legal, risk, and business stakeholders Implementation & Monitoring Build a phased implementation plan with milestones and owners Prioritize governance rollout in sequence with engineering platform and architecture delivery Establish monitoring and reporting: KPIs, compliance tracking, exception handling, escalation paths Run periodic reviews of the governance program's effectiveness and adjust as needed Required Qualifications Combined minimum of 10 years' higher education and/or operational/business analytics/systems development experience Demonstrated experience building a governance framework or program from the ground up in a large or complex organization Working knowledge of model risk management practices (e.g., SR 11-7 or equivalent) and how they extend to AI/ML systems Experience designing intake, classification, and risk assessment processes for technology or data initiatives Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, legal, compliance, and business teams Strong written communication skills; able to produce policy documents, standards, and executive-level reporting Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (risk, business, computer science, law, or similar); advanced degree a plus but not required in place of experience Preferred Qualifications Direct experience with AI-specific regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) and applying them practically Prior experience standing up or scaling a governance team, including hiring and role design Familiarity with MLOps and model deployment pipelines, enough to design controls that don't bottleneck engineering Experience with generative AI governance specifically (prompt/data leakage risk, hallucination controls, third-party LLM vendor risk) Certifications such as CRISC, CISA, or AI governance-specific credentials Experience in a regulated industry (financial services, healthcare, insurance) Skills Required Policy and standards writing Risk classification and control design Stakeholder management across technical and non-technical audiences Program/project management (roadmap building, milestone tracking, prioritization) Working knowledge of ML lifecycle and model development practices Data literacy: able to read model documentation, validation reports, and technical risk assessments Facilitation and negotiation, particularly balancing governance rigor against engineering velocity #LI-JB3 M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation. Location Buffalo, New York, United States of America

title: Head of Non-Financial Risk Management, Markets & Corporate Functions (SVP)
description: Senior Vice President, Head of Non-Financial Risk Management (NFRM), Markets & Corporate Functions Role Summary The Senior Vice President, Head of Non-Financial Risk Management (NFRM), Markets & Corporate Functions is a senior executive responsible for leading Second Line Oversight for Compliance and Operational Risk across State Street’s Markets business and designated Corporate Functions. Reporting directly to the Chief Compliance and Operational Risk Officer (CCORO), this role provides strategic leadership, independent challenge, and risk oversight to ensure that non-financial risks are effectively identified, assessed, monitored, mitigated, and reported in alignment with regulatory requirements, enterprise policies, and business objectives. The role oversees integrated NFRM activities supporting the Markets business, including trading, foreign exchange, financing, portfolio solutions, research, and technology-enabled market platforms, as well as Corporate Functions including Finance, Legal, Marketing & Communications, Corporate Audit, and Corporate Governance functions. Global Human Resources and Global Security are excluded from the scope of this role. As a member of the NFRM leadership team, this executive serves as a trusted advisor and strategic partner to senior business leaders, provides independent challenge to the First Line of Defense, and acts as a key stakeholder in governance forums and regulatory engagement. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership Lead and continuously enhance the NFRM program across Markets and Corporate Functions (excl. GHR and Global Security), ensuring alignment with enterprise risk frameworks, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices. Serve as the senior Non-Financial Risk executive for Markets and Corporate Functions, providing strategic guidance, independent oversight, and credible challenge to business and functional leadership. Advise senior executives on emerging risk, regulatory developments, control effectiveness, and risk-informed decision making. Promote a strong culture of accountability, transparency, and proactive risk management across areas of oversight. Compliance Risk Oversight Oversee a comprehensive Compliance program supporting the Markets business and Corporate Functions, including risk assessment, monitoring, testing, issue management, and regulatory change management activities. Provide advice and challenge regarding applicable laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, and internal policies impacting business activities. Ensure effective identification, assessment, escalation, and remediation of compliance risk and regulatory matters. Lead engagement and coordination with regulators on compliance-related examinations, inquiries, reviews, and remediation efforts. Provide periodic reporting and assessments to senior management, governance committees, and other oversight bodies. Operational Risk Oversight Provide Second Line Oversight for Operational Risk across Markets and Corporate Functions, including risk identification, assessment, escalation, reporting, and remediation. Oversee independent review and challenge of First Line risk management practices, risk and control assessments, issue management, incident management, loss events, scenario analysis, and lessons learned activities. Monitor existing and emerging operational risks, identify material trends, and ensure appropriate management action plans are developed and executed. Promote operational resiliency and sustainable control environments across areas of responsibility. Governance & Stakeholder Engagement Represent NFRM in key business, functional, and enterprise governance forums. Provide effective challenge and escalation of material risk matters while supporting informed business decision-making. Deliver integrated reporting on regulatory, compliance, and operational risk themes, trends, and emerging risks. Maintain strong partnerships with Enterprise Risk, Legal, Corporate Audit, Technology Risk, Financial Crimes Risk, and other control functions to promote consistent and effective risk outcomes. Support strategic business initiatives, transformation efforts, and organizational change through a risk-informed lens. People Leadership Lead, develop, and retain a global team of Compliance and Operational Risk professionals. Foster an inclusive culture focused on integrity, accountability, collaboration, and risk excellence. Establish clear objectives, performance expectations, and development priorities while building organizational capability and succession depth. Drive consistency, connectivity, and operational excellence across the Markets and Corporate Functions Non-Financial Risk teams. What We Value Deep expertise in Compliance, Operational Risk, and broader Non-Financial Risk Management within global financial services organizations. Strong executive presence with the ability to influence, challenge, and partner effectively with senior executives and governance bodies.

title: Director, Credit Risk
description: At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.  If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value. THE WORK: As our Risk team expands globally, we are seeking a strategic, analytical, and highly collaborative Director, Credit Risk. In this role, you will own credit risk across the Ripple group: setting the overarching framework for how we manage existing credit exposure while proactively structuring new, innovative lending deals (both on and off-chain) to drive Ripple’s credit business forward. You will act as a true commercial partner to Sales, Product, Trading, Legal, Finance, and Treasury every day, balancing business growth with proactive, data-driven risk management. WHAT YOU’LL DO: Own & Scale Credit Strategy: Evolve and improve Ripple’s global credit risk framework (including policies, risk appetites, underwriting standards, and limit structures), ensuring they scale dynamically with business growth. Drive Commercial Credit Structuring: Partner proactively with Sales, Product, Trading, and Financial Services teams to structure institutional credit solutions, enable new revenue streams, and facilitate deal execution within risk appetite. Pioneer On-Chain Risk Management: Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to design and build risk parameters, automated monitoring, and collateral mechanisms for on-chain lending protocols and digital asset products. Portfolio Monitoring & Stress Testing: Oversee portfolio health, concentrations, covenants, and collateral in real time. Develop sophisticated internal ratings, scorecards, and stress-testing models tailored to digital asset volatility, market dislocations, and liquidity risks. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Legal and Compliance to negotiate credit documentation, master agreements, and security packages while serving as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, the Risk Committee, and the Board. Team Leadership & Development: Build, mentor, and empower a high-performing credit team as Ripple scales globally. Data & Automation: Drive tooling and automation initiatives to continuously elevate credit monitoring, reporting, and data quality.   WHAT YOU'LL BRING:  Proven Track Record & Accomplishments: 10+ years of progressive credit risk, lending, or structured credit experience at a bank, prime broker, fintech, or digital asset firm, including 3+ years successfully building and managing teams. Commercial Mindset: Demonstrated success partnering with commercial teams to structure, negotiate, and close complex institutional lending or credit transactions. Low Ego & High Collaboration: A humble, team-first approach. You lead with empathy, actively seek out diverse perspectives, elevate those around you, and build strong cross-functional relationships. Analytical & Technical Excellence: Exceptional financial modeling skills (Excel, Google Sheets, SQL/Python a plus) and deep expertise in counterparty credit analysis, margin/collateral frameworks, and financial statement review. Crypto & Market Knowledge: Strong understanding of digital assets, stablecoins, lending protocols, and crypto market dynamics, including unique volatility, custody, settlement, and liquidity risks. Technology Forward: Experience partnering with technical teams to design and build models, leverage Agentic AI solutions to enable underwriting and monitoring, and experience integrating third party models and AI platforms in the credit risk space  Proactive & Solution-Oriented: Highly self-directed with a strong bias for action. You proactively identify emerging risks, propose pragmatic solutions, and can effectively say "no" constructively when required. Strong Communication: Superior written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex financial and risk concepts clearly to executives, board members, and external partners. Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or related field (MBA, CFA, or FRM strongly preferred). Collaborate across risk, consulting, audit, technology, business development, and marketing teams to bring the appropriate capabilities to clients. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in accounting, business, finance, public administration, or a related discipline. Minimum of 8 years of relevant internal audit, internal controls, risk, compliance, or advisory experience, including at least 5 years within public accounting or professional services. Significant experience serving government or public sector organizations, with a strong understanding of their unique governance, risk, compliance, and operational environments. Demonstrated experience leading complex internal audit, risk assessment, internal controls, compliance, and/or governance engagements. Relevant professional certification such as CPA, CIA, CISA, or other applicable risk/audit credential. Proven experience building senior-level client relationships and communicating with executives, audit committees, agency leadership, and other key stakeholders. Demonstrated success supporting business development, proposals, pursuits, and market-facing activities within a professional services environment. Strong written, verbal, presentation, leadership, and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead multiple engagements and teams simultaneously while maintaining quality and client service. title: Lead Product Manager
description: Who We Are CreateFuture is a Version 1 company and AI-native consulting partner  where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first. We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years. Our UK Benefits  35 days leave (including bank holidays).  Private medical insurance. Enhanced parental and adoption leave.  Financial coaching + 5% pension match. 40 hours of paid learning and development.  View our full list of UK benefits. CreateFuture is a  Great Place to Work-Certified™ company  and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row. Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today. The Role CreateFuture are looking for a collaborative and pragmatic Lead Product Manager to join our growing team and help us define and develop an exciting array of products over a variety of industries, technologies and domains. Our Product Managers are responsible for working with senior leadership, our internal design and engineering teams and our clients to help define and implement product strategies that are consistent with our clients’ vision. This can be from early stage research and market analysis through to development, delivery and iteration. As we rapidly scale, we’ve identified an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Manager to help support our growth.  This person will be responsible for shaping and leading client engagements. We have a variety of clients across many industries all of whom look to us to provide leadership and guidance.   You will rapidly gain their trust and guide them toward a valuable customer focused outcome. To do this you’ll use your deep understanding of product management methodologies and a consistent application of good practice.  You will also be responsible for the wellbeing of a team of product managers. You will help embed good practice and coach your team in client management techniques and the application of product management.  Does this sound like you? Do you have experience in developing Product Managers and a passion for the craft of Product Management? Do you have an empathetic leadership style with a focus on coaching each person to help grow their career and skills? If so, we’ve got a great role for you to stretch your wings and see what you’re really capable of. What you’ll be doing: Reporting into the Head of Product Operations and be able to represent the team as we grow Leading a team of Product Managers and support recruitment  Helping embed and support career progression pathways using our development framework for personal growth Providing support to the team through mentorship and coaching Acting as an escalation point for the team, helping to remove internal and external blockers as needed Supporting resourcing of Product Managers on projects Identifying training and development needs Lead clients through their digital transformation journey, ensuring long term lasting relationships are made with key decision-makers Working with the team to improve, shape and structure the Product Management ways of working About you Passionate about Product Management as a discipline and keen to keep up to date on emerging trends, as well as experimenting with new tools and techniques Recent relevant experience of leading product focused engagements  Knowledge and experience of Product Management frameworks and approaches for continuous discovery and delivery Have experience of product research and collecting evidence to support value propositions Experience working within a digital transformation and AI consultancy, delivering technology solutions to enterprise clients. Practical experience applying AI to products, services or delivery, with a good understanding of how AI can create value for clients. Experience mentoring, coaching and developing Product Managers and supporting the growth of product capability. Have experience of using data to help drive decisions and steer the direction of the product towards the client’s north star Knowledge of web and mobile technologies and practices Experience leading or supporting client discovery, workshops and product strategy, translating business needs into digital solutions. Be comfortable with ambiguity and help provide clarity in all situations    We’re particularly interested in people who are curious about how AI is changing the craft of Product Management and are actively exploring what that means in practice. Bonus points if you: Have experience shaping or delivering AI-enabled products, services or propositions, from early discovery through to live products. Understand the opportunities and limitations of LLMs, generative AI and agentic systems, and can translate these into meaningful customer and business outcomes. Have experimented with AI-native product development, using AI to accelerate research, discovery, prototyping, analysis, documentation or decision-making. Can identify where AI agents or automation could change a customer journey, business process or product experience, rather than simply adding AI features to an existing product. Understand some of the new product considerations AI introduces — including evaluation, trust, human oversight, data, governance and responsible AI. Are proactive about new AI capabilities, tools and ways of working, and enjoy helping others build their confidence and capability too. You don’t need to arrive as an AI expert. If you haven’t yet had much opportunity to put AI into practice, that shouldn’t stop you applying. What matters to us is curiosity, a willingness to experiment and excitement about how AI is changing products and the craft of Product Management. Everyone at CreateFuture undertakes AI-native training, and we’ll support you to build these capabilities and put them into practice.   What we’ll offer you: We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed. We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look. title: AI-native People Enablement Manager

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback.
